title: Solve 2 LeetCode Easy Problems
description: Pick any 2 Easy problems from LeetCode Arrays section and solve them.

title: Read about Big-O Notation
description: Understand time and space complexity. Read the GeeksforGeeks article on Big-O.

title: Write a Python script using functions
description: Write a Python program that reads a list of numbers and returns min, max and average.

title: Create a GitHub repository
description: Create a new public GitHub repo, add a README, commit and push your first file.

title: Complete 1 HackerRank SQL Easy challenge
description: Log into HackerRank and solve one easy SQL SELECT challenge.

title: Update your LinkedIn profile
description: Add your latest project or course to LinkedIn. Ensure your headline and summary are filled.

title: Read about RESTful APIs
description: Read a beginner introduction to REST APIs and understand HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

title: Revise Operating System concepts — Processes
description: Revise process states, PCB and context switching. Watch the Gate Smashers OS playlist Lecture 1.

title: Practise typing speed (aim 40+ WPM)
description: Use Typing.com or MonkeyType to practise typing. Fast typing = faster coding.

title: Read about Linked Lists
description: Study singly and doubly linked lists — insertion, deletion and traversal.

title: Write a simple HTML page
description: Create a personal profile page using HTML with a heading, paragraph, image and a link.

title: Learn about Git branching
description: Create a branch in your GitHub repo, make changes and merge it back to main.

title: Draft a 1-page resume
description: Use Internshala's resume builder or a clean template to write your first B.Tech resume.

title: Solve 5 HackerRank Python Easy challenges
description: Go to HackerRank Python domain and solve 5 easy challenges.

title: Watch 1 lecture on DBMS — ER Diagrams
description: Watch one lecture on Entity-Relationship (ER) diagrams and draw a sample ER for a library system.
